associations.rationale: Its displayed type only introduces the quotient type and does not itself state either the relation c = 1 or equivalence with the Weyl algebra.
It gives an algebra equivalence from the opaquely named HeisenbergWeylQuot to the Weyl algebra, but the displayed type does not expose that this quotient is obtained by imposing c = 1.
It states that c equals one after passage to the quotient, a consequence of the imposed relation, but does not state that this quotient yields the Weyl algebra.
